run_hypernymy_evaluation: run the main function to evaluate a Poincare embeddings checkpoint on hypernymy suite benchmarks
create_entailment_cone_model: create an EntailmentConeModel from a checkpoint dict to predict hypernymy scores for word pairs
download_hypernymy_data: download the hypernymysuite evaluation data using the download_data function
predict_hypernymy_scores: predict hypernymy entailment scores for lists of hyponym and hypernym word pairs using predict_many
summarize_evaluation_results: summarize hypernymy evaluation results by computing the average across all val_inv metrics
